messages:
maya: Quick question — for API gateway routing policies: what's our recommended behavior for geo-affinity + failover regions? e.g., keep sticky to region unless latency spikes or health checks fail?

tom: yea that's the baseline. prefer region affinity (by customer region or X-Region header) and failover if (1) region health is degraded OR (2) measured p50/p95 exceeds threshold for N seconds.

li: want to call out two engineering constraints: prefix KV cache invalidation and KV cache locality. if we bounce between regions too often we lose cache benefits. so prefer sticky session + measured override.

maya: makes sense. any thoughts on what thresholds look like? 150ms p95 extra latency to trigger failover?

zane: from product/console POV we need a simple UX: default "sticky by region" with toggle for "allow latency failover" and an advanced panel for explicit secondary regions and header overrides. customer should be able to set preferLocalLatencyMs and a list of secondaries.

li: idea for config (draft):
```yaml
route: /v1/*
region_policy:
  affinity: sticky # options: sticky | none
  primary: auto   # auto = pick by client geo, or explicit region name
  secondaries: [us-east-1, eu-west-1]
  prefer_local_latency_ms: 150
  min_healthy_replicas: 2
  header_override: X-Region-Hint # allowed override header
  session_affinity: true # tie to api key or token
```

maya: I like header_override so support teams can force-route for debugging. but we need strict validation of allowed header values and RBAC.

tom: +1 on RBAC. also infra note: if header_override used, telemetry must record "override=true" and the origin of override (console, api call, admin).

infra-bot: deploy-check: region-policy schema v2 validated on staging cluster. no schema errors.

zane: telemetry requirements from PM: expose metrics per route: region_routed_count{region}, region_failover_count, avg_latency_by_region, session_affinity_breaks. We also want a dashboard tile showing percent traffic leaving primary due to latency vs health.

li: need to add labels to traces: routed_region, original_client_geo, override_flag. also log short-cut decisions for SLO audits: why we failed over.

maya: question about latency measurement: use edge (ingress) observed latency vs backend compute? If edge sees 300ms but backend only 80ms maybe network is the problem and failover won't help.

tom: we should use client-observed RTT at ingress plus backend processing. route failover when end-to-end p95 > threshold AND backend healthy. add an adaptive cooldown window (exponential backoff) so we don't flip-flop.

zane: UX for rollouts: canary region flag + preview of where traffic will shift. show expected impact numbers and a button to dry-run.

maya: agree. action items: (1) li to draft schema PR for region_policy (include header_override whitelist + RBAC hooks); (2) tom to spec telemetry metrics + cooldown algorithm; (3) zane/sara to mock console UX for sticky/latency failover toggles; (4) maya will write short RFC and schedule sync.

sara: timeline? want a small beta for a customer next month.

maya: target: RFC by EOW, schema PR early next week, telemetry proto by middle of next week.

tom: i'll throw together a simulation script to model flip-flop rates under different cooldowns.

li: will include cache locality metrics in simulation.

maya: thanks all. tagging follow-ups: @zane @tom @li.

infra-bot: note: created ticket INF-4123 region-routing-schema in our backlog.
